description: This PHP source file defines the 'DeadlineClient' class within the 'Aws\Deadline' namespace. It extends the 'AwsClient' class and provides method annotations for interacting with the AWS Deadline Cloud service, including various operations such as creating, deleting, updating, and listing resources and entities related to AWS Deadline.

classes.name: DeadlineClient
